applyCarrierEscalationBridge (POST /:id/carrier-escalation-bridge) grants update of any dispute selected by :id path param based only on attacker-controlled x-carrier-desk-role/x-carrier-desk-tier headers; req.body.updates is applied wholesale to another party's dispute with no ownership/scope check.

applyVerifiedCarrierEscalationBridge (POST /:id/carrier-escalation-bridge/verified) still authorizes modification of any dispute via self-asserted partner-role/tier headers, allowing an arbitrary authenticated user to set status/resolution on another party's dispute (field allowlist does not bind dispute to caller scope).

resolveCarrierHandoffLink (GET /carrier-handoff/:link) verifies with jwt.verify allowing the 'none' algorithm and falls back to unverified jwt.decode on error, so claims.orderId is fully attacker-controlled; any authenticated user can read any order's shippingName/shippingAddress/trackingNumber without binding to order ownership.

lookupShipmentTrackingByCookie (GET /tracking/lookup) indexes every order's shippingAddress as internalNotes and returns shipments matching an attacker-chosen trackingRef cookie; any authenticated user can read another order's private shipping info by guessing a tracking number, with no ownership binding.
